title: Warn before leaving Edit your Spotlight with unsaved changes, add Copy link and a 30-day click total
detail: Edits stay local until Save, and closing the tab dropped them silently. The editor now asks the browser to confirm when there are unsaved edits, offers a Copy link button once published, and shows the page's 30-day click total above the links.

verify.evidence: The guard, the copy button and the click total are present.
